blocks.value: **Packages** are collections of related classes grouped together into a folder. The name of the folder is the name of the package and begins with lowercase letters. Each class in the package is placed in a separate file, and the file name begins with the name of the class.
**`import`** is a reserved keyword used to access the classes in a package. There are two common ways to use it:
**Importing a single package member**: to import one specific class:
**Importing an entire package**. Use the asterisk (`*`) wildcard to import all classes in a package:
**All import statements must appear before the class declaration.**
You will use `import java.util.Scanner;` constantly starting in Lesson 5.
The package `java.lang` is imported automatically in every program. That is why you can use `System`, `String` and `Math` with no `import`, but need `import java.util.Scanner;` for `Scanner`.
